elements.note: A landscape photo of the place where the story happens, sharp, across the middle band of the frame, with a thin dark top edge.
A crying meme character (cut-out drawing) in the lower-left of the photo, overlapping its bottom edge: the emotion of the story.

textBlocks.note: A dramatic quote from the story as the hook, white bold condensed italic with a thick black outline, on the sky of the photo.

note: How to use landscape material in 9:16: the sharp photo across the middle, and behind it the same photo zoomed to fill the frame and heavily blurred, so there are no black bars and the colours match. A meme character adds the emotion; the quote is the hook.
